top_choice_rationale: P001 honours the discovery chain that created the field: Holst on secretion and insulinotropic action of native GLP-1 in humans, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide biology, receptor action and the gut-pancreas axis, and Mojsov on identifying and synthesizing the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide. The result is independently confirmed over decades with large cardiovascular, renal and weight outcome data. The citation can state the therapeutic consequence while crediting discovery, and Mojsov's priority, though contested, is the discovery-side contribution; P002 is a close second since Knudsen's analogues solved the half-life problem, but that is engineering downstream of the discovery. Any award is preferred to no award given the maturity of the field.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; I have no documented involvement with Drucker, Holst, Mojsov or Knudsen. Past co-authorship with Perlmann and Grillner does not concern this field.
